slides.image_prompt: Gold dollar symbol scaling upward on burgundy, documentary 35mm, harsh light, film grain. Symbol, no readable text.

slides.headline: 1) FIND THE MAX PRICE YOUR MARKET WILL PAY
slides.body: A pricing consultant charges between $3,000 and $15,000 for a value analysis. This prompt does the same job in three minutes.
slides.image_prompt: Hands pressing a gold pushpin into the peak row on a chart of ascending $ symbols, that top tier circled in glowing gold, all lower rows in shadow. Deep navy background. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: warm gold against deep navy.

slides.headline: 2) BUILD PRICE ANCHORS THAT SELL THE MIDDLE
slides.body: Most businesses pick one price. A price anchor makes your main offer feel like the obvious choice by surrounding it with the wrong options.

slides.headline: 3) TURN YOUR PRICE INTO MATH THEY CAN'T ARGUE WITH
slides.body: Most clients push back on price because they can't see the return. Once they can do the math themselves, the objection disappears.
slides.image_prompt: A hand caught mid-stroke drawing three $ symbols connected by bold arrows on a large whiteboard, the final $ inside a gold circle. Bright white-lit open office. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: gold circle against bright white.

slides.headline: 4) RAISE YOUR PRICES WITHOUT LOSING A SINGLE CLIENT
slides.body: Raising prices is the fastest way to grow revenue without finding a new customer. Give current clients a 30-day window to lock in their current rate and most stay.

slides.headline: 5) FIND THE OPENING YOUR COMPETITORS LEFT
slides.body: Pricing too close to a crowded competitor is a slow death. This prompt maps the whole competitive field and finds the gap where you win on value, not on being cheapest.

slides.headline: 6) KNOW EXACTLY WHEN TO GIVE A DISCOUNT
slides.body: Giving a discount you didn't need to give costs more than any single lost deal. Most of the time, the right answer is not a yes.
slides.image_prompt: A hand mid-stroke circling one box on a large calendar with a gold pen, all surrounding boxes crossed out in red, that single box glowing bright. Deep charcoal background. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: gold against deep charcoal.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You will want these the next time a pricing question hits. Save the post, open any AI, paste the prompt that fits. Daily AI news and real skills, every day

caption:
Swipe for all 6 prompts. These do $50K worth of pricing strategy in 6 minutes, for free. 💰
